name: Freya Jayawardana
bio: Raden Roro Freyanashifa Jayawardana (born February 13, 2006), known professionally as Freya Jayawardana is an Indonesian singer and dancer, and a member of the seventh generation of JKT48 idol group, which was introduced in 2018.

credits.title: Mate's Rate
credits.overview: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.

credits.title: Operasi Pesta Copet
credits.overview: In a desperate act to get quick money, Ijal and friends embark on a high-stakes operation: pickpocketing at Indonesia's biggest music festival, Pestapora.

credits.title: A Brother and 7 Siblings
credits.overview: After the untimely death of his older sister and her husband, a struggling young architect suddenly becomes a "single parent" for his nieces and nephews. When the opportunity for a better life arises, he must choose between his love life, career, or his family.

credits.title: Dominion of Darkness
credits.overview: After losing his mother and sister, Thomas plans to resign as a priest but is tasked with assisting exorcist Rendra. Together, they confront demons possessing Kayla, his late sister's friend, while her mother Maya battles a haunting past.

credits.title: JKT48 Magic Hour: The Daydream, The Midnight Thieves, The New Dawn
credits.overview: As the lights fade, mysteries unfold. That’s when the 12 apprentices' magical journey begins.
